content: Jesudi kawadeyot fofohidok yoguk
Jesu Siloŋyot biŋa folune mihiŋiŋ niŋdi niŋguk, “Hinale, kawade yot fofohi hinek gu yabeŋ.”
Unduŋ niŋguk kaŋ Jesudibo niŋguk, “Kawade yot fofohi u yabulaŋ u memik hekidi ubulagineeŋ youpupuhene-kudapmaune molomolom mapupuheneeŋ ila-uneeŋ.”
Nai wapum diniŋ mede
Jesu Oliwa Tuwai foloŋ itune Pita, Jems, Jon agaŋ Endulu nehi hogok lokaaŋ ninadigiŋ,
“Nemek u nai deniŋ hinek mintawaak, ninimbune nadinim, eŋ nai dulalune timeŋ maŋgoŋ mintawaak?”
Unduŋ ninadigiŋ kaŋ Jesudibo yeniŋguk, “Tikamanda tihamuŋa nadinadihik tubugiyondaneeneŋ ala nadinadiŋila hatiyaneeŋ.
Metam feedi buŋa nu wotnene foloŋ yokamanda indiŋ tineeŋ, ‘Nu na iŋakoŋ.’ Unduŋ yoŋa metam fee yehitubu-giyondaneeŋ.

Hidi mik wapum mintaune gigilitŋiŋ nadineeŋ, be mik kwet niŋkade gwaŋ mintawe tubune gigitŋiŋ hogok nadiŋa munta tiŋa heheleeŋ nadibediŋa nai agaŋ dulalak mu yoneeŋ. Nemenemek undihi mintaneeŋ iŋgoŋ nai wapum adi pilap mu mintawaak.

“Kwetkwet mik mintaune kwet wapuhi be kwet kuyahi adi nehi uŋgoŋ kibikibi mindobuneeŋ. Kaŋ yokwet noli gineŋ map wapum mintawaak, eŋ kwetkwet kenim titawaak. Nemek hogohogok u mintawaak, kaŋ nai wapum diniŋ folofigita adi nai uŋaniŋ tububihila tamwoidi wapmihi yanagitne nadiiŋ undiniŋ mintawaak.

Hidi hide nadinadiŋila hatineeŋ. Nutok tiŋa Mede Momooŋ yoneeŋ kaŋ hanagila mede gineŋ hapmeneeŋ, eŋ bopyotneŋ hanagila fooŋ hehiwihitnadineeŋ, eŋ me mapme loloŋhinit be me wapuhi heki’walaŋ namandahik gineŋ looŋ yali Mede Momooŋ yohautaneeŋ.
Timeŋ Mede Momooŋnedi kwetkwet hautadapmaune nai wapum mintawaak.
Gigitne yoyauneeŋ kaŋ hanagila mede gineŋ uneeŋ kaŋ mede dediŋ yodok wendok nadibedi mu taneeŋ. Mede yodok nai tubune Uŋgoniŋ Munabulidi hanimbune yoyaneeŋ.

“Me noli nehi’walaŋ kwayahiye be dahiye bolik tiyembune widihikumuneeŋ, be behiyedi wapmihihiye bolik tiyembune widihikumuneeŋ be wapmihidi mehim-behiye’walaŋ mede wobuŋa bolik tiyembune widihikumuneeŋ.
Tiŋa metam hogohogok nutok tiŋa hidi habukwihita tineeŋ. Iŋgoŋ nemek unduŋ mintalune nebek niŋ fafaŋe tiŋa hatibaak adi Bepaŋdi tubulodaune Hatihati Kobuli kahilewaak.”
Nai kadakaniŋ hinek
(Nebek i kunataŋ, du kunali nadidakale hinek tibeŋ.) “Nemek kadakaniŋ hinehinek wendi kwet mu yayatdok gineŋ yalune kaŋ metam Judiya kwetneŋ hatineeŋ hidi momoŋ tuwai foloŋ loneeŋ.
Be me niŋ yot foloniŋ halaak adi fooŋ tinahukutŋiŋ kaliŋ yot maaneŋ mu fowaak,
be me niŋ kade gineŋ hatibaak adi yopmande tinahukutŋiŋ kaliŋ mu waak.
Hidige! Nai uŋaniŋ, tam mihiwelehinit eŋ tam eyaŋhinit adi kada, dediŋ tineeŋ.
Nemek u kadakaniŋ hinek mintawaak doktiŋa hidi Bepaŋ ninadiune u gwi nai gineŋ hinek mu mintawaak.
Koom tububihila Bepaŋdi kwet kunum yehitubu-mintagukneŋ nemek malabumuŋ mintagiŋ iŋgoŋ yendi yalakapmeŋ tiŋa mintaune mindaŋ kotigoŋ undiniŋ nemu mintawaak.

Nemek malabumuŋ u nai kweheyeniŋgoŋ mintadok iŋgoŋ oŋ, Wapumdi metamŋiye koom netok gigit yehidaneguk aditok nadiŋa nai-kabe ulatifoguk. Nai mu ulatifowe tuguk binek wa nebek nemu hatiluwek, kumuŋdapmaŋ taneŋ.
“Nai uŋaniŋ nebek niŋdi ‘Kilisto iŋoŋ hatak,’ be ‘Kilisto gwaŋ hatak,’ hanimbune medeŋiŋ mu nadimineeŋ hinek.

Nai uŋaniŋ Kilisto yalayalaŋ eŋ polofet yalayalaŋ fee mintaaŋ kudi wapuhi saŋiniŋhinit titauneeŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa Bepaŋdi metam netok gigit yoŋa yabukahileguk u nadisuhik tubugiyondadok kwanai tineeŋ, iŋgoŋ adi nadisuhik tubugiyondadok saŋiniŋ mu hatak doktiŋa kwanaimiŋ tineeŋ.
Nemek mintawaak hogohogok u agaŋ hanimbihitat. Unduŋ doktiŋa nadinadiŋila hatiyaneeŋ.”
Me Kobumuŋ busuwawaak naiŋiŋ
“Nemek malabumuŋ u mintaune yagigi mu hatiŋila meledibo mambip tibaak eŋ muyakip maaŋ hauta mu tibaak,
kaŋ bamholiŋa heki kunum gineniŋ kwehik biŋa diliteleeŋ maneeŋ. Kaŋ kunum mahamulune nemenemek hogohogok waliwali tiŋa igiyonda tineeŋ.
Unduŋ tineeŋ kaŋ nai uŋaniŋ Me Kobumuŋ adi mulukwaŋ foloŋ hauta holiholiŋe tiŋa saŋiniŋ wapumnit busuwaune kaneeŋ.
Busuwaaŋ aŋeloŋiye yeniŋkulune kwet tububihila hali wooŋ daŋ hadapmalak wendok tuwot tuŋtuŋ fodapmaaŋ metamŋiye yabukahileeŋ yehidaneguk hogohogok u yehibopneneeŋ.”
Jesudi kone foloŋ yoyout tuguk
“Bem kone u kaŋ nadineŋ. Hapmuŋ madapmaune hapmuŋ gitipmuŋ duhulak kaŋ meleyaŋ nai yoyam.
Undugoŋ hinek nemek u mintaune kaŋ agaŋ nihitubu-dulaaŋ yeme foloŋ yatak nadiyaneeŋ.
Biyagoŋ hinek hanimbe nadineŋ. Metam kumuŋdapmaŋ mu tulune nemenemek i mintawaak.
Kwetkunum adi liwe tidemeek iŋgoŋ nu’walaŋ medene adi tuwot mu liwewaak.”
Nebek niŋdi helebufa nai be mele nai mu nadilak

“Tiŋa nebek niŋdi helebufa nai be mele nai deniŋ hinek nemek i mintawaak u mu nadilak. Aŋelo heki kunum gineŋ hatiiŋ adi maaŋ mu nadiiŋ. Eŋ Bepaŋ mihiŋiŋdi maaŋ undugoŋ mu nadilak. Bepaŋ ne hogok nadilak.
Unduŋ doktiŋa nadinadiŋila hatiyaneeŋ, nai hinek mu nadiiŋ doktiŋa damodamo mu taneeŋ, hautakut tiŋa hatiyaneeŋ.
“Nemek u mintawaak adi indiniŋ. Me niŋdi yoli bikabuŋa dambek wene tipilapilayeŋiye kwanai molomolom daneyemiŋa me yeme kadoko tilak adi yeme momooŋgoŋ kadokowek niŋa yaulak undiniŋ.
Yot molom adi deniŋ hinek baak. Tebele bek, be timiŋ lekiŋgoŋ bek, be helehelede, be haniŋ bek, u hidi mu nadiiŋ doktiŋa nadiŋila woom tiŋa hatiyaneeŋ.
Tigene pilap nobu busuwaaŋ habune damo deihatneneŋ ala.
Unduŋ doktiŋa hidi be metam noli wanakaŋ indiŋ hanilat, busuwabusuwa naiŋiŋdok woom tiŋa kaipmuŋ hatiyaneŋ.”
